ai_use: AI coding assistants helped write and test the pipeline and website code. They did not produce any of the numbers: every number on this site comes from the pipeline's output files.
limitations: Only daytime detections are used in this version. Night-time detections are kept in the data but not shown.
Near-real-time detections are filtered per map cell by a static heat-source mask; standard detections are filtered one by one.
From 2026 the record uses NOAA-20 with the S-NPP eyesight curve, assuming the two instruments see fires the same way.
